preconditions.description: The size of the array a is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of queries m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r, _ in queries if queries[2] == '1')
preconditions.description: For each query of type '1', the range [l, r] is valid with 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**5 for _, _, k in queries if queries[2] == '1')
preconditions.description: For each query of type '1', the value of k is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p, _ in queries if queries[2] == '2')
preconditions.description: For each query of type '2', the position p is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for _, x in queries if queries[2] == '2')
preconditions.description: For each query of type '2', the value x is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)

postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result >= 0 and result <= 10**5) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a value between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result == min_dif for result, min_dif in zip(results, min_difs)) for result, min_difs in zip(results, min_difs_list))
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or the minimum value of dif that satisfies the conditions for the corresponding query.
